title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook spaghetti according to package directions.
While pasta cooks, fry bacon in a large skillet until crispy. Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
In a bowl, whisk together eggs and grated Parmesan cheese.
Drain pasta, reserving 1 cup of pasta water.
Remove skillet from heat and add hot pasta to the bacon.
Quickly stir in the egg mixture, adding pasta water as needed to create a creamy sauce.
Season with salt and pepper, garnish with parsley and extra Parmesan.
Serve immediately while hot.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken (tikka) cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato based gravy.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and half the tikka masala spice for at least 1 hour.
Grill or bake marinated chicken until cooked through.
In a large pan, melt butter and sauté onion until golden.
Add garlic, ginger, and remaining spices. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add canned tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Blend the sauce until smooth, then return to pan.
Add cooked chicken and cream. Simmer for 5-7 minutes.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with rice or naan.

title: Caesar Salad
summary: A green salad of romaine lettuce and croutons dressed with lemon juice, olive oil, egg, Worcestershire sauce, anchovies, garlic, Dijon mustard, Parmesan cheese, and black pepper.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: In a bowl, mash anchovies and garlic into a paste.
Whisk in egg yolk, lemon juice, and Dijon mustard.
Slowly drizzle in olive oil while whisking to create an emulsion.
Season dressing with salt and pepper.
In a large bowl, toss romaine lettuce with dressing.
Add croutons and Parmesan cheese.
Toss gently to combine.
Serve immediately as a starter or main course.

title: Chocolate Lava Cake
summary: A rich chocolate cake with a warm, gooey center that flows out when you cut into it.
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F).
Grease 4 ramekins with butter and dust with cocoa powder.
Melt chocolate and butter together in a double boiler.
In a separate bowl, whisk eggs, egg yolks, and sugar until thick.
Fold melted chocolate into egg mixture.
Gently fold in flour and salt.
Divide batter among prepared ramekins.
Bake for 12-14 minutes until edges are set but center is still soft.
Let cool for 1 minute, then invert onto plates.
Serve immediately with vanilla ice cream.

title: Beef Tacos
summary: Crispy taco shells filled with seasoned ground beef, lettuce, cheese, and salsa.
instructions: In a large skillet, brown ground beef over medium-high heat.
Drain excess fat and add taco seasoning with 1/4 cup water.
Simmer for 5 minutes until mixture thickens.
Warm taco shells according to package directions.
Fill each shell with seasoned beef.
Top with lettuce, cheese, tomato, and onion.
Add dollops of sour cream and salsa.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve immediately.

title: Greek Moussaka
summary: A layered dish of eggplant, ground meat, and béchamel sauce, baked to perfection.
instructions: Slice eggplants, salt them, and let sit for 30 minutes. Rinse and pat dry.
Fry eggplant slices in olive oil until golden. Set aside.
In the same pan, cook ground meat with onion and garlic.
Add tomatoes, cinnamon, salt, and pepper. Simmer for 20 minutes.
For béchamel: melt butter, add flour, cook for 1 minute. Gradually add milk, whisking constantly.
Remove from heat, stir in cheese and beaten eggs.
In a baking dish, layer eggplant, meat sauce, then eggplant again.
Pour béchamel sauce over the top.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 45 minutes until golden.
Let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
